success.title: 🎉 You said YES 🎉
success.text: This already feels like the best Valentine’s Day ever.

letter.text: Manan's letter - Thank you. Thank you for saying yes. I am not talking about saying yes right now, but 3years 4months and 9days ago when you said yes, which was the BEST day of my life. Thank you for being my girlfriend, thank you for being my best friend, thank you for being my everything in all times, in all places. Thank you for supporting me, for encouraging me, for loving me, and for making me a better person. My thank yous can never end, will never end. I cannot ever thank you for everything you have unknowingly done for me. But today, I want to thank you for being my valentine. I love you 3000 Shreya.
